name: usa-trip-2027
description: Family trip-cost hub for the USA trip (Hebrew, RTL). Static site in docs/, Firebase backend in functions/.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-usa-trip "node --test tests/rules/firestore.rules.mjs tests/rules/storage.rules.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:rules && node -e "setTimeout(() => {}, 6000)" && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-usa-trip "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/functions.int.mjs tests/integration/ai.int.mjs"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-usa-trip
